data.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: No reviewer agent definition file contains references to REVIEW_RESULT, MIN_SCORE, or a scores object in its output contract
- DD5: Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## What to do
Run the build script to regenerate all 13 agent files from the updated reviewer-base.md and delta files:

  cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)
  bash plugins/dso/scripts/build-review-agents.sh

This regenerates the following agent files (do NOT edit manually):
- plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-light.md
- plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-standard.md
- plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-deep-correctness.md
- plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-deep-verification.md
- plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-deep-hygiene.md
- plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-deep-arch.md
- plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-security-red-team.md
- plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-security-blue-team.md
- plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-performance.md
- plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-test-quality.md
- plugins/dso/agents/huge-diff-reviewer-light.md
- plugins/dso/agents/huge-diff-reviewer-standard.md
- plugins/dso/agents/huge-diff-refactor-anomaly.md

After regeneration, verify all agent files no longer contain REVIEW_RESULT, MIN_SCORE, or scores.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Build script runs without error
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/build-review-agents.sh
- [ ] No generated agent contains REVIEW_RESULT
  Verify: ! grep -rq 'REVIEW_RESULT' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-*.md
- [ ] No generated agent contains MIN_SCORE
  Verify: ! grep -rq 'MIN_SCORE' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-*.md
- [ ] All generated agents contain REVIEWER_HASH in their output contract
  Verify: grep -rq 'REVIEWER_HASH' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-*.md
- [ ] test-build-review-agents.sh still passes
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/unit/scripts/test-build-review-agents.sh 2>&1 | grep 'passed'
- [ ] test-reviewer-agent-review-tier.sh still passes
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-reviewer-agent-review-tier.sh 2>&1 | grep 'passed'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: GREEN: Regenerate agent files via build-review-agents.sh after reviewer-base.md and delta updates
